message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No credible vulnerability newly reported or materially updated in the last 24 hours was found to affect the monitored DLL/software components. No possible match required escalation.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only. Component names were normalized and duplicate/version-variant rows were consolidated. The primary product-list sources were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-11-01 13:10 IST through 2026-11-02 13:10 IST (2026-11-01 07:40 UTC through 2026-11-02 07:40 UTC).

### Findings

No relevant new vulnerabilities passed the freshness, source-credibility, and component-match checks. Recent entries in the [GitHub Advisory Database for NuGet](https://github.com/advisories?query=published%3A%3E%3D2026-11-01+ecosystem%3Anuget) and [npm](https://github.com/advisories?query=published%3A%3E%3D2026-11-01+ecosystem%3Anpm) did not match an inventoried package within the scan window. Vendor-family and public CVE/advisory searches likewise produced no verified in-scope finding.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A separate sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes operators, official drivers and major libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned advisories, CVE/NVD-linked records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was found with a publication or material-update time inside this scan window. MongoDB was checked as a mandatory supplemental ecosystem sweep and was not added to the DLL inventory scope.

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability review is recommended from this 24-hour scan. Continue routine monitoring; older advisories and issues affecting packages not present in the assigned DLL inventory were excluded.
